QF.id: XIII Introduction to Forwards and Futures_54

question.text: Per the current NISM VIII workbook (October 2025 NIFTY futures example, contract size 65), what is the tick size and tick value for NIFTY futures on NSE?

answer.text: Tick size: Rs 0.05; Tick value: Rs 1.25 (computed using legacy lot size 25)
Tick size: Rs 0.01; Tick value: Rs 0.25
Tick size: Rs 0.0025; Tick value: Rs 2.50 (this is USDINR, not NIFTY)
Tick size: Rs 0.05 (5 paisa); Tick value: Rs 3.25 (0.05 × 65, using the workbook's current NIFTY contract size; lot size is exchange-determined and may change)

explanation.text: The Logic: NIFTY futures tick size is Rs 0.05 (5 paisa). Tick value = tick size × current lot size. Using the NISM VIII workbook's October 2025 NIFTY example contract size of 65: tick value = 0.05 × 65 = Rs 3.25 per tick per lot. The exchange determines the lot size and may revise it from time to time; recompute the tick value when the lot size changes. The Trap: The legacy lot size 25 → Rs 1.25 tick value reflects an older specification and is no longer current. Rs 0.0025 / Rs 2.50 is USDINR. Rs 0.01 and Rs 1.00 are not NIFTY tick sizes. Cross-Exam Context: NISM VIII Ch3 gives current NIFTY specs and footnotes the exchange-determined lot size; Series I gives USDINR specs.
